definitions.explanation: The act of taking photographs with a camera.
The act of recording moving images with a video camera.

notes:
{撮影|さつえい} covers both photography (still images) and filming (video/movies). Functions as a noun or ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {撮影|さつえい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to photograph, to film
- {撮影|さつえい}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: photography/filming prohibited
- {撮影|さつえい}⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧: filming location/set
- {撮影|さつえい}⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧: director of photography
- ⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧{撮影|さつえい}: commemorative photo
- {撮影|さつえい}⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧: filming/photography permit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {撮影|さつえい}: the act of taking photos/filming (more formal)
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧: to take a photo (everyday usage)
- ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧: to take a video (everyday usage)

USAGE:
Signs saying {撮影|さつえい}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (no photography/filming) are common at museums, temples, and theaters in Japan.
